bullets.title: ORCL: Beat on AI Cloud, OCI +121% YoY; Raises FY27 Guidance; Ellison Cancels Share Sale
bullets.body: Oracle F1Q27 revenue of $19.35B (+30% YoY) beat consensus by $220M; OCI grew 121% to $7.4B, with 850MW new capacity online and $30B+ in new AI contracts booked. RPO rose 46% YoY to $664B; FY27 EPS guidance raised to $8.10; GPU contracts renewing at 20% premiums, validating pricing power. Separately, Larry Ellison cancelled his 10b5-1 plan to sell ~$7.5B of ORCL shares.

bullets.title: ADBE: 3Q Beat But NNARR -39% YoY; Freemium Strategy Limits Near-Term Reacceleration; Top Short
bullets.body: Adobe Q3 revenue $6.76B beat consensus; AI-first ARR exceeded $650M (+150% YoY) but net new ARR collapsed 39% YoY to $400M, with RPO growth decelerating into single digits for first time since FY22. Q4 guide below consensus; management is prioritizing freemium funnel over monetization. Hedgeye maintains top short citing Q4 requiring unprecedented 1.94x Q3-to-Q4 step-up in ARR. Citi cut PT to $250; JPM lowered Dec-27 PT to $315.

bullets.title: META: Upgraded to OW by JPM ($820 PT) on Muse AI Agent; Early Traction 10x Internal Tests
bullets.body: JPMorgan upgraded META to Overweight from Neutral with $820 PT (23x 2028E GAAP EPS), citing Muse AI agent launch which hit #3 in the US App Store on Day 2 with usage running 10x above testing cohorts. Muse integrates Shop Pay, supports Commerce transactions, and targets the $30tn consumer spend TAM. Wells Fargo also upgraded META to OW with $820 PT on frontier model optionality. Watermelon (next major model) expected late Sept/Oct as additional catalyst.

bullets.title: AAPL: iPhone 18 Event – Foldable Duo at $1,999, Pro/Pro Max Up $100; Lead Times Shorter YoY
bullets.body: Apple unveiled iPhone Duo foldable at $1,999-$3,199 (preorders Oct 16, available Oct 23), iPhone 18 Pro/Pro Max with A20 2nm chip at $1,199/$1,299 (+$100 YoY), and AirPods 5. JPM's lead-time tracker shows global Pro/Max at 7/19 days vs. 15/24 days YoY; China the biggest shortfall, consistent with consumers awaiting the foldable Duo. Carrier subsidies rose to $1,200 (from $1,100) reflecting the price increase. Analysts mixed: Goldman bullish on ASP expansion, Jefferies cautious on volume risk.

bullets.title: NVDA: 70% FY27 Rev Growth Reiterated; $10B Anchor Investment in Anthropic IPO; DOJ Probe on Groq
bullets.body: Jensen Huang reiterated ~70% FY27 revenue growth at multiple conferences; separately, Nvidia is reportedly considering investing up to $10B as anchor investor in Anthropic's mega IPO at $2T valuation. A DOJ investigation into Nvidia's $17B Groq licensing deal allegedly structured to circumvent antitrust review weighed on the stock (-5.2% w/w). TSMC N3 capacity shortage is expected to worsen in 2027 as NVDA consumes 55-60% of wafers for Rubin/Vera vs. <10% in 1H26.

bullets.title: AMD: Communacopia Takeaways – Data Center to 2x in 2027, MI450 Ramp Begins; CPU Supply +80% H2
bullets.body: AMD management at GS Communacopia and Citi TMT conferences reiterated data center revenue to more than double in 2027. MI450 GPU ramp begins Q3 with significant step-up in Q4 2026 and Q1 2027. Server CPU supply can grow ~80% in H2 2026 and ~70% in 2027 despite continued constraints; agentic AI driving CPU TAM expansion to $220B by 2030. AMD initiated Overweight at Piper Sandler with $600 PT.

bullets.title: AVGO: Reaffirms $115B FY27 / $230B FY28 AI Revenue Targets; $35B XPV Partnership
bullets.body: Broadcom at GS Communacopia reaffirmed AI infrastructure revenue targets: ~$115B in FY27 and ~$230B in FY28. The company announced a $35B XPV partnership to fund 20+ GW of compute capacity. Supply remains tight with extended lead times. Custom ASIC (Jalapeño) is viewed as complementary to merchant GPUs, not substitutive. Piper Sandler initiated AVGO at Overweight with $460 PT.

bullets.title: ANET: Raises 2026 Revenue to ~$12.6B (+40%); AI Cycle Multi-Year; Scale-Up Revenue in 2028
bullets.body: Arista raised 2026 revenue guidance to ~$12.6B at the Citi TMT conference. AI networking cycle expected to last several more years; purchase commitments tripled to $9.6B YoY. Scale-across is ~1/3 of AI sales and growing; scale-up pilots begin 2027 with commercial revenue in 2028. Supply commitments secured through 2027. Citi reiterates Buy with $215 PT. GS noted CSCO seeing agentic AI driving 5x network bandwidth demand.

bullets.title: GLW: Verizon Multi-Billion Fiber Deal Accelerates Springboard; Buy Initiated by Multiple Firms
bullets.body: Corning and Verizon signed a multi-year, multi-billion-dollar supply agreement for 80M+ miles of high-density optical fiber through 2032, supporting broadband and AI hyperscaler DCI. The deal allows Corning to pull forward its $20B run-rate to 3Q (one quarter ahead) and supports the path to $1B DCI revenue. Citi and JPM maintain Buy with PTs of $220 and maintain conviction on the Springboard plan; stock was up +11.7% w/w.

bullets.title: CIEN: Rising Backlog >$10B, 30%+ FY27 Growth Guided; COHR, LITE, VIAV Also Strong w/w
bullets.body: Ciena at JPM's Rising Tech Leaders Forum guided FY27 revenue growth of at least 30% YoY, with backlog expected to exceed $10B at FY26 exit and supply constrained. Scale-across TAM could reach ~$10B within the datacenter by end of decade. COHR (+8.3% w/w), LITE (+11% w/w), and VIAV (+11.2% w/w) all rallied on AI networking and optical demand. Wolfe expects VCSEL demand surge from Scale-In chip-to-chip interconnect.

bullets.title: DELL: AI Server Backlog $95B, AI Revenue Guidance to $74B FY27 (~3x YoY); RBC Initiates OW
bullets.body: Dell crushed F2Q27 with $47B revenue (+58% YoY) vs. $44-45B guidance and AI server revenue guidance raised to $74B for FY27 (~3x YoY vs. prior $60B). Backlog of $95B with pipeline multiples above that. AI customer base grew 60% in 6 months to 6,500+. Supply constraints expected to tighten in 2027 across DRAM, NAND, CPUs. RBC Capital initiated DELL at Outperform with $640 PT (+26% upside).

bullets.title: SHOP: Muse Concerns Overblown per Mizuho; Bernstein Initiates OW $160 PT; AI Commerce a Tailwind
bullets.body: Mizuho maintains Outperform on SHOP noting Meta Muse uses Stripe Link but does not bypass Shopify Payments; Shop Pay integration coming. New buyers from AI channels convert at 2x traditional rates. Bernstein initiated SHOP at Outperform with $160 PT (+26% upside). JPM reiterates OW at $185 PT, positioning SHOP as leading agentic commerce platform with low AI disruption risk.

bullets.title: DKNG: Prediction Markets EBITDA Inflection 2027-28; SCOTUS Risk Monitored; NY OSB GGR Strong
bullets.body: Citi notes DKNG EBITDA inflection in prediction markets likely 2027 or 2028 depending on NFL season acquisition pace; management tone constructive on handle growth. NY OSB week ending 9/6 showed GGR +47% YoY overall with DKNG up 270% YoY (hold rate improved). Separately, SCOTUS litigation over prediction market regulatory jurisdiction poses a risk that multiple firms are hosting calls to analyze.

bullets.title: FOXA/ROKU: DOJ Second Request on Fox's $22B Roku Acquisition; Deal Still Expected H1 2027
bullets.body: Fox Corp and Roku each received DOJ Second Requests in the merger review, extending the HSR waiting period. Fox expects the deal to close by H1 2027, subject to regulatory and shareholder approvals. GS Communacopia conference: FOXA guided record FY27 with Tubi revenue growing ~35%, political advertising 'ripping,' and Fox One tracking above expectations.

bullets.title: PLTR: DA Davidson Raises PT to $250 on AI Sovereignty and NVDA Supply Chain Win
bullets.body: DA Davidson upgraded PLTR to Buy with PT raised from $200 to $250 following AIPCon11 event focused on AI sovereignty positioning. PLTR built a supply management system for NVIDIA leveraging Nemotron addressing critical supply chain challenges. UBS hosting a Palantir update call Sept 15 with CFO dinner.

bullets.title: CRM: Claudeforce Launch at Dreamforce; Salesforce Closes $3.6B Fin Acquisition; Listen Labs Talks
bullets.body: Salesforce completed the $3.6B Fin acquisition; Anthropic's Claude models are integrated as 'Claudeforce' with 37 prebuilt skills. Agentforce ARR reached $1.5B exiting F2Q27. CRM also reported in discussions to acquire AI startup Listen Labs for ~$2.55B. JPM reiterates OW with $265 PT expecting Dreamforce to showcase double-digit FY28 subscription growth guidance and $5B+ ARR exit for Agentforce.

bullets.title: RH: Q2 Margin Beat Driven by Tariff Refunds; FY Path Hinges on Estates Rollout; MS OW $210
bullets.body: RH reported Q2 gross margin of 48.2% (vs. consensus 43.3%) and adjusted EBITDA margin of 19.4% (vs. 12.8%), largely driven by a ~$55M tariff refund. Q3 guidance +5-6% revenue growth; Q4 +16-21% with RH Estates contributing +8pts. Morgan Stanley maintains OW with $210 PT; UBS maintains Neutral noting 4Q reliance on unproven Estates rollout at scale.

bullets.title: TXN / ADI: UBS Raises AI Data Center Power Semis TAM to $13B by 2028; Prefers TXN and ADI vs INTC
bullets.body: UBS increased the AI data-center power semis TAM estimate to $13B by 2028 (from $11B), reaching $15B in 2030. Content per GW rising from $95M to $150-170M/GW beyond 2026. UBS rates TXN Buy for PSU/IBC market-share gains and ADI Buy for VRM expansion; cautious on Infineon (Neutral) due to high expectations. 800VDC delay to 2028 could reduce TAM by $500M-$1B.

bullets.title: RBLX: JPM Incrementally Positive Post-RDC; AI Infusion, Roblox Everywhere, Adult Monetization
bullets.body: JPM maintains Neutral on RBLX but is incrementally bullish following the Roblox Developer Conference. Roblox Everywhere (standalone apps, web-native, console, offline) expands SAM toward 1B DAUs. O18 US users monetize 50%+ higher than U18; 2D gaming targets higher-monetizing O25+ cohort. Weekly peak CCUs surged to 25.7M (+16% w/w) driven by 'Steal An Egg' viral mini-game and RFY algorithm updates.

bullets.title: HOOD: MS Upgrades to OW $150 PT; Mizuho Raises PT to $140; AI IPO Wave and Robinhood Chain Catalysts
bullets.body: Morgan Stanley upgraded Robinhood to Overweight with $150 PT on digital asset convergence and improving monetization across 13 business lines. Mizuho raised PT to $140 (from $130) citing AI IPO retail trading boost (SpaceX IPO drove ~24% M/M equity volume increase). Robinhood Chain fees exceeded Solana on Sept 1 ($3.75M); HOOD also named OG.com as prediction markets infrastructure partner.
